title: Grateful Dead Live at Oakland Auditorium on 1981-12-31
lineage: Cassette (1st Gen) playback on Nakamichi CR-7A, azimuth adjusted, no Dolby > Grace Lunatec V3,sample rate at 96 KHz > AES digital connection > LynxTwo soundcard in E6400 dual core processor-based PC > HD as 24 bit/96 KHz WAV > Ozone 3.0 > MBIT+ dithering to 16/44.1 KHz WAV > CDWAV 1.9 (tracking) > FLAC (level 8)
source: FOB Nak 100's > D-5 > D-5 > Maxell UDXL I cassettes

ai_review.summary: An audience‑sourced recording that captures the nostalgic New Year's Eve blaze, with standout renditions of Cold Rain & Snow, Terrapin Station and Morning Dew despite modest sound fidelity.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the historic vibe of this late‑1981 show – calling it a blistering five‑star performance and highlighting smoky versions of Cold Rain & Snow, Terrapin Station and Morning Dew. The audience recording isn’t crystal‑clear, but its ambience adds a nostalgic dimension that many listeners appreciate.

ai_rating.rationale: Show is universally praised (average ~4.8/5) while recording quality is noted as moderate; weighting yields a strong overall rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Not high‑fidelity – lacks the crispness of a soundboard but captures crowd ambience and offers an authentic “aud” dimension; some listeners note it isn’t great quality.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The show is remembered as a classic New Year's celebration with a warm, nostalgic flow that builds on the energy of the crowd and the band's improvisational spirit.
